caption_L1: This line plot is called Number people emigrating from Denmark from 2009 to 2019 , by citizenship. A linear scale with a minimum of 2010 and a maximum of 2018 can be found along the x-axis, labeled Year. The y-axis shows Foreign citizenship with a linear scale from 0 to 50,000.
